After all, The Odyssey topped the global box office in its eighth weekend of release, earning $46 million and bringing its worldwide total to $1.627 billion. Once it passes $1.672 billion worldwide (by the end of next weekend or so), it’ll eclipse Jurassic World ($1.671 billion) as Universal’s top global grosser. At that point, it will be the 11th-biggest global grosser and the third-biggest non-sequel, behind only Titanic and Avatar.
